pattern: join two same-shape tables on an id, compute a delta, rank top five, dropouts fall out via inner join
question: top 5 kids who improved the most in situps from baseline to endline
gold_sql: SELECT b."Child Name", e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS situps_improvement FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" ORDER BY situps_improvement DESC, b."Child Name" LIMIT 5
sql_duckdb: WITH improvements AS (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Child Name", e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS "Sit Ups Improvement" FROM "sportathon_baseline" AS b JOIN "sportathon_endline" AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") SELECT * FROM improvements ORDER BY "Sit Ups Improvement" DESC LIMIT 5

attempts.response:
WITH improvements AS (
  SELECT 
    b."Child ID",
    b."Child Name",
    e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS "Sit Ups Improvement"
  FROM "sportathon_baseline" b
  JOIN "sportathon_endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
)
SELECT *
FROM improvements
ORDER BY "Sit Ups Improvement" DESC
LIMIT 5;
